excerpt.zh: 被困于[sealed_system.GetName]星系内的那个邪恶的灵能实体终于被消灭，现在我们的科研船应该可以安全地探索这一没有超空间网络的独特宇域。
excerpt.en: With the destruction of the malevolent psionic entity that had been sealed in the [sealed_system.GetName] System, our science vessels should be able to safely explore this unique section of space devoid of hyperlanes.
